description: This file defines an extension to the JNI environment (JNIEnv) for Android, providing utility methods for JNI calls, class and method lookups, object creation, and exception handling, specifically tailored for the starboard platform. It facilitates easier JNI interactions and error handling in native code.

classes.name: JniEnvExt
classes.description: An extension of JNIEnv that adds convenience methods for JNI operations, exception handling, and object management.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the JniEnvExt instance before starting the application.

methods.name: OnThreadShutdown
methods.description: Performs cleanup when a native thread is about to be shut down.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the thread-specific instance of JniEnvExt.

methods.name: GetStarboardBridge
methods.description: Returns the Java object representing the StarboardBridge.

methods.name: FindClassExtOrAbort
methods.description: Finds a Java class by name using the application's class loader, aborting on exception.

methods.name: NewObjectOrAbort
methods.description: Creates a new Java object given class name and constructor signature, aborting on failure.

methods.name: NewStringStandardUTFOrAbort
methods.description: Creates a Java String from a C string in UTF-8 encoding, aborting on failure.

methods.name: GetStringStandardUTFOrAbort
methods.description: Converts a Java String to a C++ std::string in UTF-8, aborting on failure.

methods.name: AbortOnException
methods.description: Checks for JNI exceptions, describes them, and breaks into debugger if any.
